title: Checkout order submission remains on checkout with error message
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "an order confirmation page says "Thank you, Łucja Nowak!""

verdict.title: Checkout order submission remains on checkout with error message
verdict.oneLiner: The order was not confirmed: checkout remained open and displayed an error instead of the requested thank-you message and order number.
verdict.rootCause: After the customer details were entered, the checkout did not complete the order. It stayed on the checkout page and showed an error message, so no confirmation page or order number was available.
verdict.suggestion: Investigate the order-submission path and its server response. When the entered checkout details are accepted, send the shopper to a confirmation page with the thank-you message and order number; if submission truly fails, provide a specific, actionable error.

title: Cart accepts negative item quantities and calculates a negative total
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the cart Total is not a negative amount"

verdict.title: Cart accepts negative item quantities and calculates a negative total
verdict.oneLiner: The cart accepted a quantity of -3 for the Ash Glaze Mug and displayed a total of $-84.00.
verdict.rootCause: The cart does not block a negative quantity or restore the item quantity to 1. It uses the negative value to calculate the line item, cart total, and header count.
verdict.suggestion: Reject quantities below 1 on update, show a clear validation message, keep the existing valid quantity, and prevent negative values from affecting the header count or totals.

title: Search for 100% stoneware renders error page
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "A results page is shown with a heading that includes "100% stoneware"."

verdict.title: Search for 100% stoneware renders error page
verdict.oneLiner: Searching for “100% stoneware” shows an error page instead of a results page.
verdict.rootCause: The search page could not display results for the requested search term and showed an error message instead.
verdict.suggestion: Investigate why the search route for “100% stoneware” enters the error state. Ensure it shows a heading containing the query and either matching products or a no-results message.

title: Search heading renders query markup as HTML
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the results heading shows the text <s>mug</s> literally, with the angle brackets visible"

verdict.title: Search heading renders query markup as HTML
verdict.oneLiner: The results heading interpreted the search text as formatting instead of showing the characters the user entered.
verdict.rootCause: The page treated the submitted text `<s>mug</s>` as HTML. As a result, the angle brackets disappeared and “mug” was displayed with a line through it rather than as literal text.
verdict.suggestion: Escape search-query text before placing it in the results heading, then add a regression test for HTML-like queries such as `<s>mug</s>`.

title: lowercase welcome coupon code (welcome10) is accepted and takes 10% off

report.text: Hi Kiln team, I'm Priya Sharma ([redacted-email], [redacted-phone]). I typed welcome10 into the coupon box at checkout but it just says "That coupon code is not valid". The code from your welcome email should work!

reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the message "That coupon code is not valid." is not shown"

verdict.title: Welcome discount code is rejected as invalid
verdict.oneLiner: The checkout rejects the expected 10% welcome coupon instead of applying its $2.80 discount.
verdict.rootCause: The checkout treats the welcome coupon as invalid, so it shows an error and leaves the discount at $0.00 rather than applying the promised 10% reduction.
verdict.suggestion: Check the configured welcome coupon and its validation rules, then ensure it displays the success message and changes the order summary discount to $2.80.

attempts.agentSummary:
I've fixed BUG-005 but haven't verified it: I couldn't get a Kane run or a manual check. `gremlin_verify_fix` and `gremlin_guard` were both refused for permission, and so was `curl` against localhost:4000. Gremlin's Stop hook will replay the flow with Kane when I finish, and that result is the real test.

**Root cause:** `cartTotals` in `server.js` looked up `coupons[couponCode]` using exactly what the customer typed. Coupon keys are stored in uppercase (`WELCOME10`), so `welcome10`, or a code with a stray space, didn't match and got "That coupon code is not valid."

**Fix:** `cartTotals` (`server.js:35-37`) now trims the code and uppercases it before looking it up, and only accepts codes that really exist in the `coupons` table. Both the Apply button (`/api/coupon`) and placing an order (`/api/orders`) go through this function, so both now accept the code in any case. With one mug in the cart ($28.00), `welcome10` should now apply a $2.80 discount.
